title: Single-Phase RL Switching Circuit
description: Single-phase 13.8 kV AC source energizing a series RL load through a timed circuit breaker to study asymmetrical DC offset and transient inrush current.
code:

<project name="RL_Switching_1Ph" version="5.0.0" type="normal">
  <param name="time_step" value="50.0"/>
  <param name="time_duration" value="0.2"/>
  <param name="start_type" value="0"/>
  <param name="f_base" value="60.0"/>
  <hierarchy>
    <call name="Main" link="10001"/>
  </hierarchy>
  <definitions>
    <definition name="Main" type="module">
      <schematic>
        <User classid="UserCmp" defn="master:source_1" id="SRC1" x="80" y="160" orient="0">
          <param name="Name" value="AC_Source_13kV"/>
          <param name="V" value="13.8"/>
          <param name="f" value="60.0"/>
          <param name="Phase" value="0.0"/>
          <param name="R" value="0.25"/>
          <port name="out" pos="[20, 0]"/>
        </User>

        <Bus name="Bus_Source" id="B1" x="140" y="160" length="40" vbase="13.8"/>

        <User classid="UserCmp" defn="master:breaker1" id="BRK1" x="240" y="160" orient="0">
          <param name="Name" value="MainBreaker"/>
          <param name="Rclosed" value="0.005"/>
          <param name="Ropen" value="1.0e6"/>
          <param name="Tclose" value="0.02"/>
          <port name="in" pos="[-20, 0]"/>
          <port name="out" pos="[20, 0]"/>

        <User classid="UserCmp" defn="master:resistor" id="R1" x="340" y="160" orient="0">
          <param name="Name" value="Load_R"/>
          <param name="R" value="12.0"/>
          <port name="in" pos="[-20, 0]"/>
          <port name="out" pos="[20, 0]"/>

        <User classid="UserCmp" defn="master:inductor" id="L1" x="440" y="160" orient="0">
          <param name="Name" value="Load_L"/>
          <param name="L" value="0.085"/>
          <port name="in" pos="[-20, 0]"/>
          <port name="out" pos="[20, 0]"/>
        </User>

        <User classid="UserCmp" defn="master:ground" id="GND1" x="500" y="160" orient="0">
          <param name="Name" value="Earth"/>
          <port name="in" pos="[-20, 0]"/>
        </User>

        <Wire>
          <vertex x="100" y="160"/>
          <vertex x="140" y="160"/>
        </Wire>
        <Wire>
          <vertex x="180" y="160"/>
          <vertex x="220" y="160"/>
        </Wire>
        <Wire>
          <vertex x="260" y="160"/>
          <vertex x="320" y="160"/>
        </Wire>
        <Wire>
          <vertex x="360" y="160"/>
          <vertex x="420" y="160"/>
        </Wire>
        <Wire>
          <vertex x="460" y="160"/>
          <vertex x="480" y="160"/>
        </Wire>
      </schematic>
    </definition>
  </definitions>
</project>

! External Fortran 90 P-f and Q-V Droop Controller for BESS_Droop_Inverter
subroutine bess_droop_ctrl(p_meas, q_meas, p_ref, q_ref, mp, nq, f_nom, v_nom, f_cmd, v_cmd)
  implicit none
  double precision, intent(in)  :: p_meas, q_meas, p_ref, q_ref
  double precision, intent(in)  :: mp, nq, f_nom, v_nom
  double precision, intent(out) :: f_cmd, v_cmd

  ! Linear primary frequency and voltage droop laws
  f_cmd = f_nom - mp * (p_meas - p_ref) * f_nom
  v_cmd = v_nom - nq * (q_meas - q_ref) * v_nom

  ! Clamp frequency and voltage references to IEEE 1547 safe operating band
  if (f_cmd < 0.95d0 * f_nom) f_cmd = 0.95d0 * f_nom
  if (f_cmd > 1.05d0 * f_nom) f_cmd = 1.05d0 * f_nom
  if (v_cmd < 0.90d0 * v_nom) v_cmd = 0.90d0 * v_nom
  if (v_cmd > 1.10d0 * v_nom) v_cmd = 1.10d0 * v_nom
end subroutine bess_droop_ctrl
